item.title: Sonata op.5 no.7
item.description:
Corelli&rsquo;s Sonata op. 5 no. 7 is an Italian Baroque sonata. Corelli notated his taste in ornamentation in detail, making this work a representative example of Italian-style ornamentation.
Open Recorder Days Amsterdam 2023 competition Recorder: Hsing-An Lee Harpsichord: Claudio Ribeiro
item.content:encoded:
Corelli’s Sonata op. 5 no. 7 is an Italian Baroque sonata. Corelli notated his taste in ornamentation in detail, making this work a representative example of Italian-style ornamentation.
